# Visual Brand Matching Calibration Report

**Status:** Not yet run. This file will be generated by `scripts/calibrate_visual.py` in Docker environment.

## Purpose
This document reports the calibration of perceptual hash (pHash, dHash) thresholds for visual brand matching across three test sets:
- **A. Brand re-capture:** Same brand page visited twice to measure variance from dynamic content
- **B. Unrelated popular sites:** 40 popular sites to measure false-match rate
- **C. Hand-crafted lookalikes:** 10 test HTML pages mimicking brands

## To Generate This Report

Run calibration in Docker (requires Playwright, imagehash, brand_refs.json):

```bash
docker compose run --rm worker python scripts/calibrate_visual.py
```

Expected output:
- Distance distribution tables
- Recommended thresholds for pHash, dHash, favicon pHash
- False-match counts
- Lookalike detection rates
- Honest assessment of separation quality

## Default Thresholds (Uncalibrated)

Until calibration is run, the code uses these conservative defaults:

```python
PHASH_THRESHOLD = 10  # bits
DHASH_THRESHOLD = 10  # bits
FAVICON_PHASH_THRESHOLD = 8  # bits
```

These are based on common perceptual hashing practices:
- pHash distance 0–5: near-identical (same page, minor dynamic changes)
- pHash distance 6–10: similar (lookalike, same brand different state)
- pHash distance 11–20: somewhat similar (may be related designs)
- pHash distance >20: different

1. Run `build_brand_refs.py` to capture brand references
